title: Number of Squareful Arrays

monster.name: Perfect Square Wraith
monster.title: Harmonizer of Consecutive Quadratic Sums
monster.defeatQuote: Adjacent sum square test passed for every permutation!

description: An array is squareful if the sum of every pair of adjacent elements is a perfect square. Given an integer array `nums`, return the number of unique permutations of `nums` that are squareful.
solutionCode:
def numSquarefulPerms(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    import math
    def is_square(x):
        s = int(math.isqrt(x))
        return s * s == x
    nums.sort()
    used = [False] * len(nums)
    count = 0
    def backtrack(curr_val, length):
        nonlocal count
        if length == len(nums):
            count += 1
            return
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            if used[i]: continue
            if i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i - 1] and not used[i - 1]: continue
            if curr_val is None or is_square(curr_val + nums[i]):
                used[i] = True
                backtrack(nums[i], length + 1)
                used[i] = False
    backtrack(None, 0)
    return count
